turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty-five minutes. Owen's zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me. Why?
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Record it, Hale. I'll want a copy, and I'm writing down that you started it. You haven't answered my question.
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.

I haven't said a word about legal action, Hale. I've asked you a procedural question twice, and you've answered it with a threat. I'm writing that down, and I'm still waiting to hear why the zero went in before anyone called me.
I always do, Hale. It's what I'm paid for. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
